{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZtvprxkrshm6NtPFD1X","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01STMRDqsK88CgPyC4WRNGMS","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > nbody/nbody.cpp <<'EOF'\n// N-body benchmark: hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA implementation.\n//\n// Decomposition:\n//   * MPI  : bodies are partitioned into contiguous slices, one per rank. Each\n//            step every rank computes forces/velocities/positions for its own\n//            slice against ALL bodies, then the new positions are exchanged with\n//            a single MPI_Allgatherv.\n//   * CUDA : the O(N^2) force evaluation and the integration run on the GPU in a\n//            shared-memory tiled kernel. Every rank drives all GPUs that are\n//            assigned to it (GPUs on a node are divided round-robin among the\n//            ranks on that node), so a single rank on a 4-GPU node uses 4 GPUs.\n//   * OpenMP: one host thread per GPU drives the devices concurrently; the host\n//            side O(N^2) energy check, data packing and layout conversion are\n//            OpenMP parallel loops.\n//\n// The force summation keeps the sequential j = 0..N-1 order of the original\n// code per body so results are numerically equivalent to the serial version.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Error handling helpers\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__, __LINE__,          \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__));                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                       \\\n        }                                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define MPI_CHECK(call)                                                                         \\\n    do {                                                                                        \\\n        int err__ = (call);                                                                     \\\n        if (err__ != MPI_SUCCESS) {                                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error %d in %s at %s:%d\\n\", err__, #call, __FILE__, __LINE__); \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                       \\\n        }                                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nconstexpr int TILE = 256; Positions of all N bodies are streamed through\n// shared memory in tiles; the j loop visits bodies in increasing index order\n// exactly like the serial reference. base < n; base += TILE) {\n        const int jj = base + threadIdx.x;\n        __syncthreads();\n        tile[threadIdx.x] = (jj < n) ? posAll[jj] : make_double4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int limit = min(TILE, n - base);\n        if (active) {\n#pragma unroll 8\n            for (int j = 0; j < limit; ++j) {\n                const double4 q = tile[j];\n                const double dx = q.x - p.x;\n                const double dy = q.y - p.y;\n                const double dz = q.z - p.z;\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n                Fx += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        double4 v = vel[li];\n        v.x += DT * Fx;\n        v.y += DT * Fy;\n        v.z += DT * Fz;\n        vel[li] = v;\n        p.x += v.x * DT;\n        p.y += v.y * DT;\n        p.z += v.z * DT;\n        posNew[li] = p;\n    }\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host code\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Per-GPU state owned by one MPI rank.\nstruct DeviceSlice {\n    int device = 0;\n    int begin = 0; Each rank\n// uses OpenMP for its share; the result is reduced to rank 0.\ndouble computeTotalEnergyDistributed(const std::vector<double4>& posAll, const std::vector<double4>& velLocal,\n                                     const int begin, const int count) {\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(posAll.size());\n    const double4* pos = posAll.data();\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic li < count; ++li) {\n        const int i = begin + li;\n        const double4 pi = pos[i];\n        double e = 0.0;\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pi.x;\n            const double dy = pos[j].y - pi.y;\n            const double dz = pos[j].z - pi.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            e -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n        energy += e;\n    }\n\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&energy, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    return total;\n}\n\n// std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies chosen at launch time (32..256) so that even small per-GPU slices\n// spread over all SMs; the per-body arithmetic is identical for any BLOCK.\ntemplate <int BLOCK>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK) nbodyStepKernel(const double4* __restrict__ posAll,\n                                                         double4* __restrict__ vel,\n                                                         double4* __restrict__ posNew,\n                                                         const int n, const int begin,\n                                                         const int count) {\n    __shared__ double4 tile[TILE];\n\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * BLOCK + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = li < count;\n\n    double4 p = make_double4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n    if (active) p = posAll[begin + li];\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int base = 0; base < n; base += TILE) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < TILE; t += BLOCK) {\n            const int jj = base + t;\n            tile[t] = (jj < n) ? posAll[jj] : make_double4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int limit = min(TILE, n - base);\n        if (active) {\n#pragma unroll 8\n            for (int j = 0; j < limit; ++j) {\n                const double4 q = tile[j];\n                const double dx = q.x - p.x;\n                const double dy = q.y - p.y;\n                const double dz = q.z - p.z;\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n                Fx += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        double4 v = vel[li];\n        v.x += DT * Fx;\n        v.y += DT * Fy;\n        v.z += DT * Fz;\n        vel[li] = v;\n        p.x += v.x * DT;\n        p.y += v.y * DT;\n        p.z += v.z * DT;\n        posNew[li] = p;\n    }\n}\n\n// Launch helper: use the largest block size for which the slice still\n// occupies every SM of the device (FP64 throughput per SM is the limiter).\nstatic void launchStep(const double4* posAll, double4* vel, double4* posNew, const int n, const int begin,\n                       const int count, const int numSMs, cudaStream_t stream) {\n    auto blocksFor = [&](int b) { return (count + b - 1) / b; };\n    if (blocksFor(256) >= numSMs) {\n        nbodyStepKernel<256><<<blocksFor(256), 256, 0, stream>>>(posAll, vel, posNew, n, begin, count);\n    } else if (blocksFor(128) >= numSMs) {\n        nbodyStepKernel<128><<<blocksFor(128), 128, 0, stream>>>(posAll, vel, posNew, n, begin, count);\n    } else if (blocksFor(64) >= numSMs) {\n        nbodyStepKernel<64><<<blocksFor(64), 64, 0, stream>>>(posAll, vel, posNew, n, begin, count);\n    } else {\n        nbodyStepKernel<32><<<blocksFor(32), 32, 0, stream>>>(posAll, vel, posNew, n, begin, count);\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns = s[:old_kernel_start] + new_kernel + s[old_kernel_end:]\n\n# {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgZusrTEdesUXHGekTUv5","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"All edge cases pass, including fewer bodies than ranks, more ranks than GPUs, and the large 131k-body run. The build directory is removed, so only the two original files remain.\n\n## What changed\n\n**`nbody/nbody.cpp`** is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program, compiled by nvcc:\n\n- **MPI**: bodies are split into contiguous slices per rank. Each step every rank computes its slice against all bodies, then one `MPI_Allgatherv` exchanges the new positions. Final state is gathered to rank 0, which does all printing, so output format is unchanged.\n- **CUDA**: the O(N²) force loop plus velocity and position update run in one fused, shared-memory tiled kernel in double precision. Each thread owns one body and walks j = 0..N-1 in the original order, so the arithmetic matches the serial code exactly. The block size (32 to 256) is chosen per launch so small slices still cover every SM, since the FP64 pipe per SM is the limiter on these GPUs.\n- **OpenMP**: GPUs on a node are divided round-robin among the ranks on that node, and each rank drives its GPUs with one OpenMP thread per device. So a single rank on a 4-GPU node uses all 4 GPUs. OpenMP also parallelizes the O(N²) energy check, which is distributed across ranks and reduced, and the layout conversion and result packing loops.\n- Pinned host buffers, non-blocking streams, a warm-up launch outside the timed region, and barriers around the timing.\n\n**`nbody/CMakeLists.txt`** enables the CUDA language, compiles nbody.cpp as CUDA, links MPI and OpenMP, and defaults `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` to `native` (override it for a heterogeneous cluster). No new files or dependencies.\n\n## Correctness\n\nWith FMA contraction disabled on both sides, the hybrid build under 4 ranks and under 1 GPU produces a hash bit-identical to the serial build. This shows the GPU performs the same operations in the same order. With default flags the results differ only at the 1e-12 relative level because gcc and nvcc contract FMAs differently, and results are identical regardless of rank or GPU count.\n\n## Performance (10 steps, this node, 4× RTX 3090)\n\n| Bodies | Original serial | Hybrid 1 GPU | Hybrid 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1024 | 77 ms | 6 ms | 6 ms |\n| 8192 | 4973 ms | 87 ms | 49 ms |\n| 65536 | n/a | 4815 ms | 1266 ms |\n\nScaling from 1 to 4 GPUs at 65536 bodies is 3.8x. Run with `mpirun -np <ranks> ./nbody ...`; one rank per node is enough to use every GPU on that node."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2634,"cache_read_input_tokens":57058,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2634},"output_tokens":745,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"cfc721e3-5193-4e10-aebb-b61f6976e668","uuid":"61e9ca34-f0b5-4a49-9de9-47b127aaca6c","timestamp":"2026-10-31T07:22:30.636Z","request_id":"req_011CgZusr3S7soznZVaiPkA4"}
